public_rationale: The January 15, 2026 retrospective reports that every ARC-AGI-2 task was solved by at least two independent non-expert human testers [e1]. On December 5, 2025, ARC Prize's top verified refinement system scored 54% [e2]. On December 23, Poetiq reported up to 75% using GPT-5.2 X-High on the public evaluation set, a different split [e3]. These late-2025 results document remaining failures on human-solvable tasks under tested conditions. They support the forecast under the contract's public-capability standard and do not demonstrate superiority across human intellectual work by December 31, 2025 [e1, e2, e3].
limitations: The evidence does not inventory undisclosed systems or every system and inference configuration available by the deadline.
Benchmark failures show gaps under tested conditions, not impossibility under every time, compute, or reliability allowance.
Poetiq's December 23 result is developer-reported and uses a different evaluation split from the verified December 5 result.
The assessment uses the claim's all-intellectual-work threshold; these benchmarks do not establish a general definition of AGI.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AGI superior to the smartest individual humans will not arrive by the end of 2025.

statement.excerpt: Skeptical of this, I offered Musk a $1 million bet that AGI superior to the smartest individual humans would not arrive by the end of 2025, reprinted here for those who missed it.

from_speaker: AGI superior to the smartest individual humans
would not arrive by the end of 2025
any intellectual work that any human can do
at least one piece of intellectual work that the very best humans can do that AGI can’t
our_interpretation: Use Marcus's explicit explanation: superiority must extend across human intellectual work, rather than mean a higher average score on selected tasks.
Assess demonstrated practical capability using public evaluations of systems available by the deadline. Benchmark failures are evidence of capability gaps, not mathematical proof of impossibility.
The wager amount is background, not a claim about company finances.
criteria.support_condition: Evaluations covering the late-2025 frontier identify intellectual tasks that humans can solve but the leading AI systems still cannot reliably perform, with no demonstrated system closing that gap by the deadline.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A system available by December 31, 2025 demonstrates general intellectual capability meeting or exceeding the best humans across tasks, including independently tested unfamiliar tasks.

evidence.explanation: The retrospective report says every ARC-AGI-2 task was solved by at least two independent non-expert human testers. Its analysis identifies continuing generalization limitations in 2025 AI systems.
The organizer's leading verified result still left substantial failures on human-solvable reasoning tasks. This supports a remaining capability gap, although it is an early-December snapshot.

Poetiq reported up to 75% on the public evaluation set using GPT-5.2. This is material evidence of further progress, but uses a different evaluation split and does not demonstrate universal human-level task coverage.
